### God, Our Ultimate Trail Guide
Author: Jessica Brodie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wholly-loved/wholly-loved-feb-21.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 31:8
Points:
- Walking through unfamiliar and dark seasons of life naturally stirs feelings of uncertainty and fear.
- Facing a major transition in leadership, Joshua and the Israelites needed reassurance before stepping into the Promised Land.
- Moses reminded them that their true security was God's ongoing presence, not an earthly leader.
- Believers can press forward with confidence knowing that God leads the way and will never forsake them.

### Courageous Because of Who God Is
Author: Trillia J. Newbell
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-february-3-2025.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 31:6
Points:
- Stepping into the unknown or facing daunting assignments can easily provoke fear.
- God understands human frailty and repeatedly commands His people not to give in to dread.
- Rather than leaving people to rely on their own strength, God provides His personal presence as the solution to fear.
- Believers can walk forward boldly because God goes with them and will never abandon them.
